what_to_detect: An ability of a permanent that refers to the X it became monstrous with (a becomes-monstrous trigger) uses that X: the trigger's resolution deals or gives an amount equal to the counters the monstrosity X resolution put.
near_miss: A monstrosity X resolution on a permanent already monstrous: no counter, no becomes-monstrous trigger, nothing using X.
record_fields: counter_change delta on the monstrosity resolution (acting line Monstrosity$ X)
the BecomeMonstrous trigger's resolution damage_dealt amount

what_to_detect: A permanent that was monstrous left the battlefield and returned, so it is a new object that is not monstrous: a later monstrosity resolution on it puts +1/+1 counters (counter_change).
near_miss: A monstrosity resolution on a permanent that became monstrous and has stayed on the battlefield since: no counter_change.
record_fields: the subject's earlier monstrosity resolution and its later zone_change back to the battlefield (a join across records)
